title: Other weird recurring settings in your dreams?
content: Besides Mall World I have this recurring dream setting I can only describe as 1900 World, it’s like a jarring contrast to all my other dreams almost as if the setting was formed by another mind and just fell into my head accidentally. It’s basically like everything is from 1900-1940 and there’s no context within the dream for understanding things like smartphones for example or any modern tech. The colors in this dream are kind of rusty and grimey. There’s often an old dock and an old theatre. It’s just like Mall World where the dream doesn’t have much of a plot just wandering around “doing something” but it’s not clear what I’m really doing in the dream. Anyone else have time hopping dream settings?
